scope: fault injection with real SDK signatures and simulated transport; not real Devnet/Phantom
checks: signature rejection leaves no receipt and sends nothing
response lost after send resumes with the same signature and no resend
unresolved signature times out and restart never replaces it
status service failure preserves the receipt
processed-only status cannot be reported as confirmed
confirmed on-chain failure is not accepted or resubmitted
account verification failure is retried without a new transaction
completed restart validates historical receipt without obsolete state assertions
